newsitem.title: USA: United Tech unit gets $804 mln engine deal.
newsitem.headline: United Tech unit gets $804 mln engine deal.

text.p: The Pratt & Whitney engine unit of United Technologies Corp has been awarded an $804 million U.S. defense contract for work on the Joint Strike Fighter program, the Navy said.
Pratt & Whitney will provide engines for competing demonstrator models of the fighter jet built by teams headed by Lockheed Martin Corp and Boeing Co.
The U.S. Air Force tentatively wants to buy 2,036 of the jets, the Marine Corps 642, the Navy 300 and the British Royal Navy 60 in the next century.
Some analysts have estimated that eventual sales of the fighter could mean more than $170 billion for firms involved in future contracts.
